infoPlist.NSCameraUsageDescription: KC uses the camera only when you choose to take a photo for a post, listing, chat message or your profile picture.
infoPlist.NSPhotoLibraryUsageDescription: KC opens your photo library only when you choose a photo to add to a post, listing, chat message or your profile picture.
infoPlist.NSUserNotificationsUsageDescription: KC sends notifications about new messages, replies and updates on items and requests you're involved in. You can turn them off in Settings.
infoPlist.NSLocationWhenInUseUsageDescription: KC uses your approximate location only while you use the map, to show listings near you. It is never shared or stored.
